credit: Photo: John Deere (studio image via deere.com), used here for internal parts reference.

model.note: Part outlines are traced from John Deere's studio photo and are approximate. The engine, filters, reel alternator, battery and hydraulic tank sit under the hood and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from JD Replacement Parts Guide TC604185 (Dec 2023) and operator's manuals omuc21596 / omuc39830e. Read the engine plate before ordering: the Tier 4 (DPF) engine takes a different fuel filter and fan belt.

rops.name: ROPS (2-post) and seat belt
rops.desc: Check the ROPS mounts and seat belt daily. Check torque on the ROPS hardware at every 500 h or yearly service. Do not drill, weld or modify the ROPS.

seat.name: Operator seat
seat.desc: The seat switch is one of the safety interlocks with the park brake and mow switch: check them daily before mowing.

steering.name: Steering wheel
steering.desc: Tilt wheel on hydrostatic power steering to the rear wheels. Grease the steer yoke pivot, rear axle spindles (2) and pivot every 50 h (JD Multi-Purpose SD Polyurea).

console.name: Steering column and TechControl display
console.desc: TechControl is passcode protected and sets mow speed, transport speed and reel speed. Backlap is switched on in the TechControl service menu (park brake on, units lowered, operator off the seat, slow idle). On the Tier 4 engine the DPF regeneration screens show here: let regens finish, repeatedly stopping them leads to a recovery regen.

hood.name: Engine hood
hood.desc: Under the hood: Yanmar 3-cylinder diesel, air cleaner, engine and reel alternators, radiator and oil cooler. After use blow out the radiator and oil cooler. Daily: engine oil, hydraulic oil, coolant (expansion tank half full when hot), air restriction indicator and dust valve.

screen.name: Cooling air intake and rear screen
screen.desc: Keep the intake screen, radiator and oil cooler clean: clean after every use. Coolant 7.3 L JD Cool-Gard II (no more than 50 % concentrate if mixing); change coolant and thermostat every 2000 h or 24 months.

lights.name: Work lights
lights.desc: Front work lights on the cowl. Check before mowing in low light. 12 V system, 500 CCA battery.

frame.name: Front frame, footplate and drive shaft
frame.desc: Grease every 50 h and straight after washing: drive shaft U-joint, yoke pivots (5), front lift cylinder ends (5). Machine grease is JD Multi-Purpose SD Polyurea (or SP HD Moly). Check and tighten wheel hardware at 5 h after any wheel change.

liftF.name: Front lift arms and cylinders
liftF.desc: Carry the three front cutting units. Grease the front lift arms (3), rear lift arms (2) and rear lift cylinders (2) every 50 h. Replace the lift arm pivot bushings every 1000 h or yearly.

hoses.name: Hydraulic hoses
hoses.desc: Check daily for leaks and chafing. Check all hoses and clamps at 50 h and every 250 h. The reels are electric: there is no hydraulic reel circuit, the hydraulics drive traction, steering and lift.

tyreFL.name: Front tyre, left (drive)
tyreFL.desc: 24 x 13.00-12 smooth turf tyre at 83 kPa (12 psi); the EU manual allows 12 to 14 psi maximum. Check pressures daily; check wheel hardware at 5 h.

tyreR.name: Rear tyre (steer)
tyreR.desc: 24 x 13.00-12 smooth turf tyre at 83 kPa (12 psi). Grease the rear axle spindles and pivot every 50 h.

engine.name: Engine: Yanmar 3-cylinder diesel
engine.desc: Two versions: Yanmar 3TNV84T 1.5 L with a 48 V / 180 A reel alternator (S/N 65001-, EU/older) or Yanmar 3TNV86CT 1.6 L Tier 4 with DPF and a 56 V / 240 A reel alternator (S/N 120001-). Which one Surrounds Mower 1 has is not confirmed: read the engine plate and check for DPF screens. Oil 5.3 L with filter (EU manual 5.7 L, fill to the dipstick), JD Plus-50 II. Oil and filter every 250 h. Valve clearance 0.15-0.25 mm (3TNV84T) or 0.20 mm (3TNV86CT).

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Change with the oil every 250 h.

fuel.name: Fuel tank, water separator and final filter
fuel.desc: Diesel tank 43.5 L (the EU manual table says 61.7 L: check the tank decal). Drain the separator bowl when the red ring has lifted. Final fuel filter every 500 h or yearly: MIU800645 on the non-Tier 4 engine, MIU803127 on the Tier 4; fit one, not both. Key on for 2 minutes to let the electric pump prime before starting. Match the separator element to the one in the bowl (M811032 or MIU802421).

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Primary element RE68048 every 300 h (parts guide) or 500 h/yearly (operator's manual), secondary RE68049 every 500 h. Don't open the canister unless the restriction indicator shows red. Check the dust unloading valve daily.

alternator.name: Reel alternator and belts
alternator.desc: A belt-driven 48 V or 56 V alternator powers the five electric reel motors. A slipping or worn reel-alternator belt causes reel faults: check it every 250 h, 30 mm deflection at 50 N, replace if more. Fan belt about 12 mm at 98 N: TCU38089 (non-Tier 4, 1475 mm) or TCU30780 (Tier 4).

hydraulics.name: Hydraulic tank, filter and strainer
hydraulics.desc: 37.8 L JD Hy-Gard J20C (drain plug right front of the tank). Filter UC34161 at 50 h, then every 750 h or yearly with the oil, or earlier if the restriction indicator says so. Clean or replace the suction strainer on the left side at 750 h, torque 34 +/- 7 N.m.

battery.name: 12 V battery
battery.desc: 12 V, 500 CCA. Engine alternator 45 A (EU) or 55 A (NA) is separate from the reel alternator.

cooling.name: Radiator, oil cooler and thermostat
cooling.desc: 7.3 L JD Cool-Gard II. Change coolant and thermostat every 2000 h or 24 months. Clean the cores after every use.

cuFL.name: Cutting unit, front left
cuFL.desc: 18 in. QA5 cutting unit with its own electric reel motor. Fairways and surrounds at 4 mm: Tournament bedknife UC18877. Daily paper test on all five units. Grease every 50 h and after washing: reel bearings both ends (until it purges from the vent), front and rear rollers both ends and the height adjuster, with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease. PowerBrush belt TCU32422 if a brush is fitted.

cuFC.name: Cutting unit, front centre
cuFC.desc: 18 in. QA5 cutting unit with its own electric reel motor. Fairways and surrounds at 4 mm: Tournament bedknife UC18877. Daily paper test on all five units. Grease every 50 h and after washing: reel bearings both ends (until it purges from the vent), front and rear rollers both ends and the height adjuster, with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease. PowerBrush belt TCU32422 if a brush is fitted.

cuFR.name: Cutting unit, front right
cuFR.desc: 18 in. QA5 cutting unit with its own electric reel motor. Fairways and surrounds at 4 mm: Tournament bedknife UC18877. Daily paper test on all five units. Grease every 50 h and after washing: reel bearings both ends (until it purges from the vent), front and rear rollers both ends and the height adjuster, with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease. PowerBrush belt TCU32422 if a brush is fitted.

cuRL.name: Cutting unit, rear left
cuRL.desc: 18 in. QA5 cutting unit with its own electric reel motor. Fairways and surrounds at 4 mm: Tournament bedknife UC18877. Daily paper test on all five units. Grease every 50 h and after washing: reel bearings both ends (until it purges from the vent), front and rear rollers both ends and the height adjuster, with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease. PowerBrush belt TCU32422 if a brush is fitted.

cuRR.name: Cutting unit, rear right (behind the machine in this photo)
cuRR.desc: 18 in. QA5 cutting unit with its own electric reel motor. Fairways and surrounds at 4 mm: Tournament bedknife UC18877. Daily paper test on all five units. Grease every 50 h and after washing: reel bearings both ends (until it purges from the vent), front and rear rollers both ends and the height adjuster, with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease. PowerBrush belt TCU32422 if a brush is fitted.

body.name: Rear body, fenders and engine bay pan
body.desc: Black body panels round the engine bay and rear wheels. Keep the engine bay free of clippings: clean the machine and the cutting units after use, then grease straight after washing.

reel.name: Reel (18 in., 7, 11 or 14 blade)
reel.desc: Confirm the blade count fitted before ordering (TCA19348 7-blade, TCA19349, TCA23622 14-blade). Backlap about every 10 h (club practice): set about 0.076 mm at the ends, enable backlap in TechControl, brush compound end to end, wash off while still reversing, then reset 0.025-0.050 mm. Grind at about 200 h (club practice): spin and relief grind, land 1-2 mm, then backlap.

bedknife.name: Bedknife and bedbar
bedknife.desc: At 4 mm fit the Tournament knife UC18877 (or UC28164 / TCU36878). The fairway knives UC28157 (4.8 mm min) and JRM 4BD250222 (4.4 mm min) are below their rating at 4 mm and will scalp. Bedknife to reel 0.025-0.050 mm, one flat at a time alternating sides. Grind the knife 6.5 deg top, 5 deg front relief. New screw in every hole at 7 N.m from the centre out.

motor.name: Electric reel motor
motor.desc: One motor per unit, fed by the reel alternator. There are no hydraulic reel motors and no reel-circuit pressures to test. Reel faults: check the reel-alternator belt and the motor connector first.

froller.name: Front roller
froller.desc: Grease both ends every 50 h with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease (or cornhead grease). Grease the reel bearings until it purges from the vent.

TCU30780.name: Fan belt, Tier 4 engine
TCU30780.note: Only if the engine is the Tier 4 (DPF) 3TNV86CT. Emmetts $71.80 ex GST (Oct 2026).

MIU802421.name: Fuel separator element (other engine variant)
MIU802421.note: JD guides disagree on which engine takes it: match the element in the bowl. RDO $71.11 (club paid $81.79 ex GST).

TCA19348.name: Reel 18 in. 7-blade
TCA19348.note: Emmetts $831.36 ex GST (Oct 2026). Confirm blade count fitted.

TY25876B: JD dealer or local 12 V 500 CCA
UC28164: Bedknife 18 in. Low cut (min HOC 2.0 mm)
TCU36878: Bedknife 18 in. hardened, stationary HOC 2 mm
UC23445: Bedknife 18 in. Fairway high cut (min HOC 7.6 mm)
